gameDesignNote: Canonical Ribbon names, flavor, origin, and sprites are Pokémon references. Which StreamLink Achievement awards which Ribbon is this game's design — not official Pokémon behavior.
duplicateStrategy: Each Achievement maps to a unique canonical Ribbon. Level-milestone badges (kanto-10, level-20, level-50) reuse the same Ribbon as the closest Achievement when those badges exist independently of an Achievement row.
prestigeMethod: Low = onboarding/participation/souvenir/normal-rank contest Ribbons. Mid = distinguished contest ranks, Battle Maison skill, event/festival Ribbons. High = League Champion, Tower/World Championship, Legend, Master-rank contest, gold memory Ribbons.
